headlines.title: Mass power outages after Thanksgiving Day storms
headlines.description: Dramatic video shows firefighters battling a blaze in the height of a storm that also caused flooding in coastal neighborhoods and toppled trees across the Northeast. Hundreds of thousands are still without power in the Midwest and Northeast. NBC News’ Steven Romo reports from the storm zone.

headlines.title: Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade Postponed for First Time Ever
headlines.description: For the first time in its 100-year history, the world-famous Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade has been postponed. The unprecedented decision by Macy’s and New York City was made after forecasters warned of potentially dangerous storm conditions. NBC’s Erin McLaughlin reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Biggest Black Friday deals as holiday retail rush kicks in
headlines.description: It’s expected to be a record-breaking holiday shopping season. On this Black Friday, Adobe Analytics says discounts are averaging 30%. NBC’s Brian Cheung breaks down where shoppers can get the best deals, and what you should wait to buy.

headlines.title: Cyber attack on U.S. Air Force cloud-based platform
headlines.description: A U.S. official confirms the Air Force’s cloud-based platform “Cloud One” was breached by hackers. An Air Force spokesperson would not offer any details about the severity of the hack and who may be responsible. NBC News’ Kelly O’Donnell reports.

headlines.title: New Look at Upcoming Doc on Kate Middleton’s Cancer Journey
headlines.description: In a new clip from the highly anticipated documentary, “Heal,” Kate Middleton describes being faced with her own mortality after being diagnosed with cancer and how she found comfort in speaking to others. NBC’s Daniele Hamadjian reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Live updates: The best Black Friday deals up to 70% off, handpicked by a shopping expert
headlines.description: We found the top trending Black Friday 2026 deals across Amazon, Target, Walmart and more. Don’t miss these worthwhile steals before they sell out.

headlines.title: How are you affording the holidays?
headlines.description: After a year of high gas prices, inflation ticking back up and a lot of Americans feeling pessimistic about the economy, we want to know how people are affording the annual wave of holiday gifts, travel and entertainment costs.

headlines.title: ‘Shocking’ decline seen in hep B vaccination against incurable virus, including babies with infected mothers
headlines.description: Fewer newborns are being vaccinated against hepatitis B, an incurable infection that can lead to liver disease, a large new analysis has found.

headlines.title: 2026 Rockefeller Center Christmas Tree Arrives in New York City
headlines.description: A magnificent Norway spruce has made its journey from West Edmeston, New York, to Rockefeller Center. The tree will undergo a glow-up ahead of the lighting ceremony on Dec. 2.

headlines.title: Zohran Mamdani has successful surgery for torn Achilles and will make full recovery, staff says
headlines.description: Surgery to repair New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani’s Achilles tendon went well Friday and he’s now recovering at Gracie Mansion, his press secretary said.

headlines.title: Princess Kate wants people to learn from her cancer journey in vulnerable new documentary
headlines.description: LONDON — Catherine, Princess of Wales, reveals how cancer treatment terrified and changed her in a very personal documentary she said she hopes will help others reckon with the disease.

headlines.title: Thanksgiving shooting at Airbnb teen party ends with 1 dead, 6 wounded in Florida
headlines.description: Gunfire erupted at a teen girl’s birthday bash in Florida on Thursday, leaving one dead and six others wounded after they showed up to the booze-filled celebration advertised as a “Girls Gone Wild Pajama Party,” officials said.
